evidence_gaps: Fresh sanitised runtime forensics generated within two hours.
Per-trade decision timestamp, chain, strategy/version, asset, notional and settlement denomination.
Contemporaneous executable entry/exit quotes, quote age, route, liquidity, sellability, size-dependent price impact and realised slippage.
EVM gas used and effective gas price, priority/builder payments, reverted/replaced transaction costs, atomicity outcome and confirmation latency.
Solana base and priority fees, compute budget, landing/simulation outcomes, account creation/closure and refundable-rent reconciliation.
Complete reconciled cash flows and realised money-weighted NET P&L after platform/profit-share fees.
Failure taxonomy and counts separating STRATEGY_MARKET loss from EXECUTION and INFRASTRUCTURE failure, including monetary cost and missed-opportunity labeling.
Forward out-of-sample observations including rejected signals and failed attempts, stratified by chain, size, asset and market/congestion regime.
Evidence of parameter freeze, absence of look-ahead leakage, independence/deduplication and uncertainty estimates.

Before any promotion: fresh runtime evidence, positive cost-complete out-of-sample money-weighted net with conservative uncertainty above zero, acceptable drawdown/failure bounds, and no dependence on a single asset or regime.

proposals.downside_risk: Stricter completeness rules will reduce usable samples and may expose historical records as non-comparable.

evidence.detail: Window records contain profit, fees and slippage but no chain, settlement currency, gas/priority fee, price-impact, refundable-rent or failure-cost fields.
Net may be supplied by the caller; otherwise it is gross profit minus gross loss, fees and slippage only.
Metrics sum monetary fields across all selected windows without chain/currency normalization.

proposals.expected_effect: Comparable, auditable money-weighted NET P&L by strategy and chain, with portfolio totals converted using decision-time and exit-time valuation rather than mixed native units.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 closed, cost-complete observations per strategy-chain-size bucket across at least 3 independent market regimes, with every failure classified and monetary costs reconciled.
proposals.rationale: Summing SOL, ETH and other native units is economically invalid, while caller-supplied net values can conceal omitted costs. Record immutable cost components and settlement denomination per observation. Classify adverse outcomes as STRATEGY_MARKET when an executed position loses after complete costs, EXECUTION when execution quality or transaction failure consumes edge, and INFRASTRUCTURE when RPC/indexer/queue failure prevents or corrupts measurement.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay SHADOW windows with independently recomputed net = proceeds minus principal, venue fees, price impact, slippage, gas or Solana base/priority fees, non-refundable account costs and failure costs. Stop and mark DATA_INCOMPLETE if denomination, cost provenance or reconciliation is missing; fail the hypothesis if recomputed aggregate net is non-positive or differs from recorded net beyond a predefined rounding tolerance.

proposals.downside_risk: Quote collection can be rate-limited and may bias the sample toward routes for which infrastructure responds successfully.

evidence.detail: Solana leader observations are emitted as SIGNAL_ONLY_MISSING_CURRENT_EXECUTABLE_EDGE with zero liquidity/sellability and needs_quote_feature_adapter=true.
Only observations with an available executable outcome receive quote-simulated net; these are explicitly excluded from promotion evidence.
Legacy SHADOW accounting uses fixed estimated entry and exit network/priority fees, which may not represent congestion-dependent execution economics.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents leader momentum or win history from masquerading as executable Solana profit and identifies whether losses arise from market selection or execution infrastructure.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 independent candidates, including at least 30 executable round trips and all rejected/failed attempts, spanning congestion and liquidity conditions over no less than 14 days.
proposals.rationale: Historical leader quality is not current executable edge. Solana requires contemporaneous round-trip quotes, size-dependent impact, base and priority fees, account/rent treatment, sellability, quote age, landing probability and failed-attempt cost.
proposals.shadow_test: For each timestamped candidate, capture decision-time buy and sell quotes at the intended size, price impact, slippage limits, base/priority fees, account costs, simulation result and eventual executable mark-out. Treat failed or stale quote/simulation/landing attempts as EXECUTION or INFRASTRUCTURE outcomes, not strategy losses. Stop if cost fields are missing or quote age exceeds the configured bound; reject the hypothesis if cost-complete forward net is non-positive.

proposals.downside_risk: Promotion becomes slower and genuinely sparse strategies may remain dormant for long periods.

evidence.detail: Common executable rules use fixed net-edge and quote-age thresholds across both chain types after adapter normalization.
Research promotion evaluation requires only 8 trades, 3 windows and profit factor 1.10.
The live-stage state machine can advance after 3 and 8 realised trades, samples too small to establish durable money-weighted performance.

proposals.expected_effect: Reduces false promotion caused by tiny samples, favourable regimes, mixed economics or repeated correlated observations.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 closed cost-complete trades per strategy-chain pair, 30 calendar days, 3 regimes, and a conservative confidence interval for mean money-weighted net that remains above zero; promotion additionally requires fresh runtime forensics under two hours old.
proposals.rationale: A positive aggregate can conceal chain, size or regime dependence. EVM must include gas bidding, builder payments, revert/replacement costs and atomicity; Solana must include priority fees, landing failures, account economics and non-atomic exit risk. Promotion evidence should be forward, chain-stratified and cost-complete.
proposals.shadow_test: Freeze parameters, then evaluate chronologically out of sample by chain, notional bucket and volatility/congestion regime. Require positive money-weighted net and profit factor after every attributable cost, while reporting STRATEGY_MARKET loss separately from EXECUTION and INFRASTRUCTURE failure cost. Stop on non-positive cumulative net, cost incompleteness, concentration in one asset/regime, or a predefined execution-failure ceiling.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote or declare profitable from the current evidence.
rejected_ideas.reason: Runtime forensics are missing and generated_epoch is zero; architecture alone cannot establish realised executable profitability.

rejected_ideas.idea: Optimise leader or strategy selection for win rate.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count ignores loss magnitude and execution costs; durable money-weighted NET P&L is the objective.

rejected_ideas.idea: Loosen liquidity, sellability, simulation or positive-edge gates to increase trade frequency.
rejected_ideas.reason: More trades without positive executable edge increase adverse-selection and failure exposure.

rejected_ideas.idea: Combine Solana and EVM native-unit P&L into one raw total.
rejected_ideas.reason: Unlike denominations and chain-specific cost structures make the result economically meaningless.

summary: Architecture-only review completed and evidence hash/commit verified. The repository contains strong fail-closed execution concepts and correctly avoids treating quote simulations as realised profit, but Strategy Lab accounting can aggregate unlike native currencies, accepts externally supplied net profit, omits explicit price-impact/gas/priority/rent fields, and does not economically attribute execution failures. Solana SHADOW inputs lack current executable quote-edge evidence. Consequently no profitability, CANARY-readiness or LIVE-readiness claim is supported. STRATEGY/MARKET losses must be measured separately from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE costs and failures.
